5. **Exercise**: At the expiration date, if you hold the put option and the market price of the underlying stock is below the strike price, you can choose to exercise the option and sell the stock to the option writer at the strike price. If the market price is above the strike price, you would lose the premium you paid for the option and not exercise it.

6. **Exercise Rights**: The holder has the right to exercise the put option at any time before the expiration date (if they choose to), but after the expiration date, only the option writer has the right to decide whether to exercise the option.
